question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Microsoft)

calls.reasoning: Microsoft guided Q1 FY27 revenue to $89.85-90.95B (16-17% YoY on $77.67B); consensus ~$90.6-90.7B. Last four quarters beat consensus by ~1.2-2.9% (Q4 FY26: $90.0B vs $87.6B, +2.7%; Q1 FY26 +~2.9%; Q2 +~1.2%; Q3 +~1.8%). Applying ~2.2% typical beat to consensus gives ~$92.4B. FX roughly neutral (dollar softer Jul-Aug, rallied Sept). Downside: AI-demand softening/capacity limits; upside: Azure guided ~45% cc and has repeatedly beaten. No prediction market found (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi searched).

- Company guidance (Jul 2026 Q4 FY26 call): total revenue $89.85-90.95B, 16-17% YoY growth; new segments Agents & Infra $75.15-75.75B, Devices & Consumer $14.7-15.2B; Azure ~45% cc growth; capex >$50B (investing.com, bitget, stocktitan).
- Prior-year comparable Q1 FY26 revenue: $77.67B.
- Consensus (Oct 2026): ~$90.61-90.7B (MarketBeat, Visible Alpha via cmelitegroup); Intelligent Cloud estimates revised up ~2.5% for Q1.
- Recent reported vs consensus: Q4 FY26 $90.01B vs $87.61B (+2.7%), Azure +43% vs ~40% est (investing.com). From memory/background: Q1 FY26 $77.67B vs ~$75.5B; Q2 FY26 $81.27B vs ~$80.3B; Q3 FY26 $82.89B vs ~$81.4B. Beat range ~1.2-2.9% over last 4 quarters.
- Quarterly revenue series (background): 65.6, 69.6, 70.1, 76.4, 77.7, 81.3, 82.9, 90.0 ($B).
- FX: DXY softened through Jul-Aug 2026, then rose ~2.4% in September after Fed's Sep 16 hike to ~101.5 at Sep 30; up 2.6% YTD (portfolio-terminal) — quarter-average effect roughly neutral vs July guidance.
- Downside context: AI-infra sentiment cooling (Barclays, Oct 17 2026); FT reports Microsoft shifting from Anthropic to own tools; MSFT stock near one-year low (GeekWire preview).
- FY27 accounting change: data-center useful life extended 15->25 years (affects profit, not revenue).
- Searched, absent: any prediction market (Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold) on MSFT revenue; any preannouncement.

calls.reasoning: Q1 FY27 guidance is $89.85-90.95B (midpoint $90.4B, +16-17% y/y on $77.67B), and consensus is about $90.6-90.7B. In FY26 Microsoft beat its guidance midpoint every quarter, by roughly +2.1%, +1.5%, +2.1% and +3.2% (Q4 may include discrete items). A ~2% beat implies ~$92.2B, or about 18.7% y/y. That fits the realized 16.7-18.4% y/y growth through FY26 and Azure being guided to ~45% cc. A small trim from the runs' $92.4B reflects September dollar strength and AI-demand cooling headlines. No market on total revenue was found.
calls.reconciliation: There were two disputes. (1) The typical beat size: Runs 1 and 2 put it at ~2.2% (median $92.4B), while Run 3 used $1.2-2.4B absolute (median $91.9B). This is factual but couldn't be fully checked without web access. My own recollection of the FY26 guidance ranges (Q1 $75.5-76.6B, Q2 $79.5-80.6B, Q4 $86.7-87.8B) gives beats of +1.5% to +3.2% vs. the midpoint, which supports ~2%. That points to roughly $92.0-92.4B. (2) FX and the Q4 one-offs: the dollar rose in September, and Q4's discrete items may have inflated its beat. I treat both as judgment and shade the median slightly, to $92.2B. Report timing (Oct 28 vs Oct 29) doesn't matter for resolution. The tails are about 2% on each side: a result below $90.2B would mean missing the guidance midpoint, which hasn't happened recently, and one above $94.5B would need a >4.5% beat.
